OPEN_BATCH028_A_corrects_this_sessions_b: EV-STR-001 IS MISFILED, NOT MISSING. The dispatching session relayed an ideation finding that it has no file; the Coordinator checked and found it at the ledger ROOT rather than ledger/evidence/, declaring a non-canonical hypothesis_id, with DEC-20260718-003 misfiled the same way. THE DISTINCTION IS LOAD-BEARING: an absence is repaired by writing a record, but A MISFILED ARCHIVED RECORD MAY NOT BE REPAIRED BY MOVING IT, so acting on the relayed diagnosis would have produced the forbidden repair.
OPEN_BATCH028_B: The knowledge-promotion gate is stated purely in hypothesis dispositions, so KN-CAND-BATCH024-A - whose trigger (b) is now MET and recorded as met - can NEVER satisfy it. Named rather than deferred a third time.
THIS_COMMIT_IS_THE_PRE_REGISTRATION: RR-IVR-1 is fixed IN THE OPENING DECISION, BEFORE THE CONTRACT AUTHOR IS ENGAGED AT TASK-20260802-003: seeds 90001-90020, k = 20, deterministic substitution from 90021, primary VR at bits-16 u=2, R_PERM = 2000. Hash-binding it here is what makes that checkable rather than asserted - the author of the control specification cannot shape the reading rule to the design, because the reading rule already exists and is committed.
filed_as_a_control_not_a_new_experiment: It changes the OBJECT and not the apparatus; it is EXP-LPF-001's own named control, commissioned in terms by RR-LPF-2's L-4 disposition and discharging the RT049-CTRL-5 debt; and A NEW EXP ID WOULD ORPHAN the admissible calibration and the hash-bound driver from their contract, since every reported quantity is a ratio whose DENOMINATOR is an EXP-LPF-001 calibration array. Immutability holds because rule 4 forbids EDITING, not ADDING - all new files at new paths under control_ivr/, frozen before any datum, on the RR-LPF-1 to RR-LPF-2 precedent.
gates_retired_for_cause: The calibration arm as a re-run, because re-running it adds PURE NOISE TO THE DENOMINATOR of the ratio under test. The plant ladder ABSENT rather than waived, because this control certifies NO power against contamination. Movement-at-every-rung re-forms as `every ratio carries its interval`, no clause reading a moving_rungs list or gamma floor. The four-change-cap diff replaced by the HARDER non-inheritance check that an imported clause would silently re-adjudicate BATCH-027. No sixth discipline. SELF-VOIDING on hash equality of five artifacts.
it_cuts_both_ways_and_that_is_the_point: IF between-instance sd EXCEEDS the iid sd, the one reject is noise AND THE NINE NON-REJECTIONS ARE NEARLY VACUOUS. IF it is below, both are stronger. The detection-floor table published in EV-LPF-001 - u=2 plus or minus 1.7 percent, u=3 4.5, u=4 13, u=5 39 - could be right by a factor of 1 or wrong by a factor of about 16, and nothing in the campaign currently distinguishes those.
not_a_branch_structure: One suspending condition I-0, one report, and three CONDITIONAL LICENCES - C-WIDE at VR >= 1.2596 at BOTH cells, C-TIGHT at VR <= 0.7297 at both, C-INDET otherwise - plus C-REPRO-1 which is yardstick-free and primary, C-REPRO-2 whose circularity is declared and which is VOID if C-WIDE fires, and C-MEAN which is COMPUTED AND EXPRESSLY NOT READ BY ANYONE. Multiplicity handled in advance by the both-cells rule at per-rung at most 0.0025 and FWER at most 0.01243, with the cell-independence approximation declared because both cells share the same seeds.
the_alternative_that_matters: NOT a 26 percent inflation. It is sqrt(130816/512) = 15.98, the factor of sixteen implied by each of 512 factor-base coordinates appearing in 511 pairs, sitting about 12.7x ABOVE the detection floor. At k = 20 the design separates VR = 1 from VR = 16 with essentially certainty. Derived at nu = 19: interval multipliers 0.79392 and 1.37041, floors 1.2596 and 0.7297, power at true VR of 16, 4, 2, 1.5 and 1.26 equal to 1.000, 1.000, 0.990, 0.818 and 0.50.
the_coordinator_corrected_the_control_it: THE 512 PER-INDEX RATES ARE NOT INDEPENDENT - each pair enters exactly two - so the sqrt(p(1-p)/511) free rider as specified by RT-20260801-082 is an UNCONTROLLED STATISTIC, which is the exact failure docs/inventor-protocol.md section 3 names, appearing inside the control that exists to enforce section 3. Repaired by a PERMUTATION NULL over the 130,816 pair slots at R_PERM = 2000, exact conditionally on the total and costing no factorization. Both nulls are reported and neither alone, and W3 records that the two instruments are NOT SUBSTITUTES - a clean free rider licenses no statement about VR.
what_it_does_not_buy_declared_in_advance: NO RESOLUTION BELOW ABOUT 26 PERCENT. An all-C-INDET outcome licenses only `not shown wrong by more than about a quarter` and NEVER `the band is correct`. The indeterminate branch is phrased as `not resolved at k = 20` IN THOSE WORDS in the frozen rule.
what_it_does_not_do: IT DOES NOT ADVANCE H-LPF-001. The control PRODUCES what RT049-CTRL-5 demands, but `replicated` needs the statistics re-read under RR-LPF-2 at those instances - AND RR-LPF-2's BANDS ARE THE THING UNDER TEST. That is circular, it is declared as circular, and the re-read is ranked as the successor rather than smuggled into this batch.
why_this_batch_exists: BATCH-027 measured HEUR-DS-1 for the first time and branch L-4 returned inconclusive. It can be neither strengthened nor dismissed because of OBJ-RT082-1: THE FROZEN BAND IS CALIBRATED TO A NOISE SOURCE THE REAL ARM DOES NOT HAVE. OBJ-NULL-UNIF is 130,816 iid draws whose 200-replicate sd matches sqrt(p(1-p)/n) to about 8 percent at every rung. OBJ-REAL IS NOT A SAMPLE - its 130,816 values are determined by 512 factor-base x-coordinates, each appearing in 511 pairs, n = C(512,2) = 130816 exactly - and the scale that actually fluctuates, ACROSS CURVE INSTANCES, was never measured because there is one instance per cell.
